user.title: Pixoo64 Setup
user.description: Welcome! Let's connect your Pixoo64 screen to Home Assistant. Please provide the basic required information to get started.

data_description.pixoo_ip: The local IP address of your Divoom Pixoo64 device (e.g., 192.168.1.50).
data_description.media_player: Select the primary media player you want the screen to track.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Pixoo64. Please check the IP address.

init.title: Advanced Settings & APIs
init.description: Configure optional APIs and smart home integrations. None of these are strictly required, but they significantly improve the experience.

data_description.spotify_client_id: Highly recommended for 100% accurate album art. Create a free app at developer.spotify.com.
data_description.pollinations_key: Required ONLY if you want AI to generate conceptual art for songs without covers. Get a free key at enter.pollinations.ai/keys.
data_description.musicbrainz_enabled: A free fallback to search for album covers if the original is missing.
data_description.light_entity: Select an RGB light entity to automatically sync with the album cover's dominant colors.
data_description.wled_ip: If you have a WLED device, enter its IP address here to sync it with the music.
